links.outcome: Readability of chatbot patient-education responses versus average American reading level
links.effect: Gemini 1.0 responses were significantly more readable (closest to average American reading level) than ChatGPT 3.5, ChatGPT 4, and Claude; numeric grade levels not reported in abstract.
links.quote: Gemini 1.0 generated statistically significant differences in ease of readability (closest to average American reading level) than responses from ChatGPT 3.5, ChatGPT 4, and Claude.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the readability and quality (via DISCERN and readability formulas) of baseline responses from six commercial LLMs to patient education questions about Achilles tendon rupture without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
